'''Sovi''' was an individual who served as a [[Aide/Legends|personal assistant]] to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] attack on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Amidala tasked Sovi with co-ordinating with the [[Chandrilan/Legends|Chandrilan]] senatorial offices at the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] regarding the participation of Amidala's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] in the relief effort on Chadrila.<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege" />
